video_title: The Jaylen Brown trade has 'STUNNED EVERYONE IN THE NBA' 😱 Shams on the Celtics-76ers deal | Get Up

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics decided to split up Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: it was time to split up the duo of Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown
quotes.quote: The Celtics made a couple of assessments. The first assessment was it was time to split up the duo of Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown. You cannot have both of those guys on supermax contracts. And then it was the assessment that they would be moving on clearly no matter what with Jaylen Brown. They were aggressive in seeking out packages, but when teams called on Jayson Tatum, they were given a complete no. When teams called on Jaylen Brown, they were wide open.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics know Jaylen Brown better than any other team
quotes.excerpt: The Celtics know Jaylen Brown better than every other team in the league
quotes.quote: The Celtics know Jaylen Brown better than every other team in the league. They have had him, they have rewarded him with contract extensions, but they have also put him on the trade block multiple times, including this time with Giannis Antetokounmpo the first time around. They have decided after that first round playoff loss, they decided we have to get out.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Trading Jaylen Brown for Paul George is a clean trade
quotes.excerpt: it's a clean trade. You're trading one max player for another max player
quotes.quote: It's a clean trade. You're trading one max player for another max player, and then you just add in the draft picks with it. You're taking on a player that's making 35 percent of the cap, you better have a good balance with your team as far as the ability to basically gut it totally.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics traded Jaylen Brown because they dislike his shot profile
quotes.excerpt: the thing with Jaylen Brown is they don't like his shot profile
quotes.quote: I talked to some analytics folks too, and they said the thing with Jaylen Brown is they don't like his shot profile. The shot profile is where you take your shots, how often you take them, and they view him as a low value player in that way. All that said, you don't trade him to the Philadelphia 76ers if you think the 76ers are a player away from getting to the Finals.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers are moving further away from being anchored by Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: Philly is moving further and further away from being attached to Joel Embiid
quotes.quote: Philly is moving further and further away from being attached to Joel Embiid in a way that anchors them. We saw what they were able to do last season and he was available for less than 50 games. I am pretty confident in saying that. Brown, Maxey, Edgecombe, you got guards that have a ton of speed.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's health is the biggest X-factor for the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: the biggest X-factor is going to be Joel Embiid. That the health and the availability
quotes.quote: The biggest X-factor is going to be Joel Embiid. That the health and the availability of Joel Embiid will play a significant role as far as where this team goes.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers have character flaws that need to be fixed
quotes.excerpt: We think of Philadelphia 76ers as having character flaws
quotes.quote: We think of Philadelphia 76ers as having character flaws. When you get walked down, I am telling you guys, it was one of the most amazing scenes being in Philadelphia on Mother's Day weekend and they embarrassed themselves. And now you're going to say Paul George is the problem, Jaylen Brown is the answer, and Joel Embiid and everything else of the competitive character and makeup of that team is going to be fixed within the span of a year.

quotes.speaker: Monica McNutt
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers need to figure out their backup center situation
quotes.excerpt: they're going to have to figure out this backup point guard or backup center situation
quotes.quote: They're going to have to figure out this backup point guard or backup center situation now that Mitchell Robinson has also moved on to Boston.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Indiana Pacers are a team to watch in the East
quotes.excerpt: I don't see the Indiana Pacers, a team that was one game away from winning the NBA championship
quotes.quote: I don't see the Indiana Pacers, a team that was one game away from winning the NBA championship a couple of years ago, and they basically roll back the same roster with Tyrese Haliburton and Eneveka Zubac. I'd put them in the conversation, not in the Knicks conversation, but in the conversation with all these other teams.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics have only won one playoff series since winning the title
quotes.excerpt: the Celtics have won a grand total of one playoff series since winning the NBA title
quotes.quote: Until they actually do something, the Celtics have won a grand total of one playoff series since winning the NBA title. Uno.
